g.text: General Arrangement – Top, Port Side, Front, Rear & Longitudinal Cut‑away (A‑A)
LOA 44.0 m | Max Ø 6.0 m | Solar‑array span 30.0 m | Scale 10 px = 1 m
Port half removed – starboard internal layout shown
1. All dimensions are nominal, tolerances omitted.
2. Solar arrays shown deployed; radiators in operative configuration.
3. Cut‑away presents starboard internal systems; port side removed.
4. Landing gear is shown fully extended for ground handling.
5. Propulsion module houses three gimbaled vacuum‑optimized engines.
